name: sentinel
description: Sentinel: local-first memory and consistency with a shared CLI and VS Code brand system.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sentinel/core && npm run build -w @sentinel/vault && npm run build -w @sentinel/llm && npm run build -w @sentinel/analyzer && npm run build -w @sentinel/guardian && npm run build -w @sentinel/webview && npm run build -w @sentinel/cli && npm run build -w sentinel-vscode
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run package
